summary: Sagimet Biosciences furnished an 8-K on September 30, 2026, disclosing an updated investor slide presentation (Item 7.01) and two other events (Item 8.01): positive 52-week Phase 3 ASC40-304 open-label extension results for denifanstat in moderate-to-severe acne vulgaris, run by China license partner Ascletis, and the suspension and termination of the ATM prospectus supplement tied to the August 14, 2025 Leerink Sales Agreement, halting new at-the-market sales absent a fresh prospectus or registration statement; the Sales Agreement otherwise remains effective. No special-situation transaction, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated, so this is a routine disclosure.
